[SWS_DM_01054] Starting to transmit PDIDs after positive response
⌈
After the positive response of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A)
with transmissionMode different than stopSending was sent, the DM shall start to send
the periodic DIDs.
⌋
